onboarding.drive: Connect Google Drive to back up your images and see them on other devices.

document.title: Start with a document
document.body: A document is the report you're building: an ordered set of figures with a page format you choose.

capture.title: Snap the label
capture.body: LabelSnap finds the label's edges, straightens it and enhances it. Adjust the corners if needed. It works without signal at the bench.

review.title: Text is read for you
review.body: On-device OCR reads the label and fills fields like lot number and expiry. Add a caption and a footnote, then Save & next.

export.title: Export, already formatted
export.body: Every capture becomes a numbered figure. Export to PDF or Word whenever you're ready.
